thread:
maya: APAC GPU onboarding failingkeystore handshakes erroring, kubelet shows KMS decrypt rpc Unavailable. Billing shows NATGW surge. Anyone?
kevin: saw this when deep-sni was enabled + audit exporter fanout increased. Lots of short TLS sessions -> conntrack blowup.
lia: ops-bot: conntrack privnet-ngw-3 jumped 40k -> 510k in 15m, NATGW scaled out.
ops-bot: ALERT conntrack_count(privnet-ngw-3) > 500k. estimated extra cost $95/hr.
maya: APAC routes keystore via NATGW (no privatelink yet). Short-term options: disable deep-sni for keystore OR add targeted SG to allow 443 to keystore-proxy ip.
kevin: mitigation plan: 1) temp SG allow 10.240.5.12:443 from kubelet CIDR with 6h TTL, 2) sysctl nf_conntrack_max=800000 on NATs, 3) throttle audit exporter. Document justification for compliance.
lia: security-bot: whitelisting requires JIRA + compensating control note for audit. Ensure change log entry.
maya: running SG + conntrack tweak now: `aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0a1b2c --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 10.240.0.0/18 --description "temp keystore allow, TTL=6h"` and `sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=800000`.
ops-bot: maintenance window 10:40z-11:10z.
maya: mitigation applied, conntrack down to 72k, most nodes joined. creating ticket for privatelink (jordan to own) and postmortem in #incidents.
kevin: add runbook to ticket: check SNI rules, route (privatelink vs NAT), conntrack, and audit exporter settings.
lia: filing compliance note and tagging security owner.
maya: closing thread unless regressions.
